summary.text: Lisa Hango is a Republican state representative from Franklin-5 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since February 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; she is also on the ballot as a Democratic candidate, having advanced from both parties' August 11 primaries.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Hango was born in Catskill, New York, and earned a B.A. in economics from the University of Vermont in 1984.
She assumed office in the Vermont House on February 14, 2019, and Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments from 2019 through 2024 as the General, Housing and Military Affairs Committee.
